name: memory_restore
description:
Loads a saved checkpoint to restore session context.
Use when: resuming work after switching clients, starting a new session after a break, or inspecting what was happening at a previous save point.
Scope: local filesystem. No network access.
Not for: reading individual facts (use memory_read), searching (use memory_search). Use name='latest' to restore the most recent checkpoint.

name.description: Checkpoint name to restore. Use 'latest' for the most recently saved checkpoint.
